company.name: CEQUENS
company.shortDescription: CEQUENS provides APIs and omnichannel communication tools for messaging, voice, and customer engagement across digital platforms.
company.description:
CEQUENS is a multi-award-winning communication solutions provider. We are on a mission to simplify customer engagement through our innovation-focused solutions engineered for customer-first organizations. Our product suite includes APIs such as SMS, WhatsApp for business, voice, and verification solutions. It aims to solve our customers’ unique problems and cultivate deeper human connections between businesses and individuals in every market we play. 

With 5 office locations and 128+ direct network connections, CEQUENS empowers more than 1000 businesses in over 107 countries with faster, better, and stronger communication.

CEQUENS is an ISO-certified and PCI DSS compliant company and is recognized as a Meta Business Partner as well as a service provider for Microsoft Teams Phone and WhatsApp Business.
